podcast.title: Early Grunge Pioneers
podcast.body: Malfunkshun was mentioned as one of the bands featured in the early years of grunge during the mid-1980s. "It featured bands like the Melvin's, Mel function and Green River."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Predecessor to Mother Love Bone – Early Band
podcast.body: Malfunkshun was an earlier musical group from which Mother Love Bone evolved. The band featured a musician named Greg Gilmore, who also had connections to Skinyard. "They had evolved out of malfunction, a group featuring a dude named Greg Gilmore, who, for a time, had been in Skinyard with Jack and Dino and Daniel House."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Evolution from Malfunkshun – Group's Origin
xref.body: Mother Love Bone developed out of an earlier group named Malfunkshun, which notably featured Greg Gilmore, a musician who had also spent time in Skinyard with Jack Endino and Daniel House.
